_note: Hand-labelled relevance judgements at DOCUMENT level (doc_id = file stem). Chunk-level labels are derived later from character offsets once chunking exists. 'kind' tags what each query is designed to stress: 'keyword' = exact terms appear in the doc (favours BM25), 'semantic' = paraphrase with little word overlap (favours embeddings), 'multi' = more than one relevant document.
